description: Full history of one number as CSV: FX since 1999 (fx.EUR.USD), World Bank since 1960 (wb.{code}.{country}), ECB yields (ecb.yield10y.IT), Eurostat, power prices (smard.price.day), sunspots (noaa.sunspot-number). Example: {"id":"wb.FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG.DE","from":"2000"}; {"q":"inflation germany"} finds ids.
name: get_series
title: Get a time series
